【Fee】Adults ¥8,800 | Middle school and under ¥2,200 (includes guide, lunch, materials, insurance)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Hanno Tanetotsuchinouen Farm staff

【What to bring】Drinking water, hat, towel, gloves, etc.
